node.label: Governance & Schemes
node.summary: Government schemes, administration, Census, civil services and regulation.

facts.text: Kerala transferred **35 IAS officers**; K.R. Jyothilal became Additional Chief Secretary, Home and Vigilance.
facts.plain: Kerala transferred 35 IAS officers; K.R. Jyothilal became Additional Chief Secretary, Home and Vigilance.

facts.text: The law behind them: the **Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025**, which merged four older laws.
facts.plain: The law behind them: the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, which merged four older laws.

facts.text: The Home Ministry plans **FRROs** in every State capital by **2027**. There are now **20**, including new ones at Jaipur, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Aizawl and Amravati.
facts.plain: The Home Ministry plans FRROs in every State capital by 2027. There are now 20, including new ones at Jaipur, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Aizawl and Amravati.

facts.text: Census is a Union List subject (**Entry 69**); the governing law is the **Census Act, 1948**.
facts.plain: Census is a Union List subject (Entry 69); the governing law is the Census Act, 1948.

facts.text: Debate: caste data for welfare and reservation, and privacy worries after a trainer linked Aadhaar to citizenship (officials denied it).
facts.plain: Debate: caste data for welfare and reservation, and privacy worries after a trainer linked Aadhaar to citizenship (officials denied it).

facts.text: The **first caste enumeration** in independent India (Q.10C): SC/ST pick from a list, others type their caste; there is no separate OBC column. Aadhaar (Q.37) is optional.
facts.plain: The first caste enumeration in independent India (Q.10C): SC/ST pick from a list, others type their caste; there is no separate OBC column. Aadhaar (Q.37) is optional.

facts.text: Registrar General and Census Commissioner: **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**. Enumerator training framework: **PRAMAN**.
facts.plain: Registrar General and Census Commissioner: Mritunjay Kumar Narayan. Enumerator training framework: PRAMAN.

facts.text: **40 questions**, **13 new** compared with 2011. It is the **first digital census**, filled on a mobile app by about **34 lakh** enumerators.
facts.plain: 40 questions, 13 new compared with 2011. It is the first digital census, filled on a mobile app by about 34 lakh enumerators.

facts.text: Census Phase 2 (**Population Enumeration**) starts **1 Dec 2026** in UP, Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab; the rest of India in **Jan 2027**.
facts.plain: Census Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) starts 1 Dec 2026 in UP, Uttarakhand, Goa and Punjab; the rest of India in Jan 2027.

facts.text: MGNREGA's accountability rested on **social audit** by the Gram Sabha (Section 17 of the old Act).
facts.plain: MGNREGA's accountability rested on social audit by the Gram Sabha (Section 17 of the old Act).

facts.text: Dropped from the May draft: an FIR when there's prima facie financial irregularity, and action-taken reports to local bodies. Critics say this weakens deterrence and local oversight.
facts.plain: Dropped from the May draft: an FIR when there's prima facie financial irregularity, and action-taken reports to local bodies. Critics say this weakens deterrence and local oversight.

facts.text: New grievance rules (Rural Development Ministry): complaints on any matter, logged online the same or next day, inquiry within **7 days**, resolution within **15 days** or escalation.
facts.plain: New grievance rules (Rural Development Ministry): complaints on any matter, logged online the same or next day, inquiry within 7 days, resolution within 15 days or escalation.

facts.text: **VB-G RAM G** = Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin). It replaced **MGNREGA** in 2026 under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.
facts.plain: VB-G RAM G = Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin). It replaced MGNREGA in 2026 under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.

facts.text: Chhattisgarh foundation day (CM **Vishnu Deo Sai**): **Mahtari Vandan Yojana** has paid **₹20,708 crore** to **68 lakh** women; a **State Capital Region** (Raipur, Nava Raipur, Durg, Bhilai); CM Helpline **1076**; Seva Setu (953 services).
facts.plain: Chhattisgarh foundation day (CM Vishnu Deo Sai): Mahtari Vandan Yojana has paid ₹20,708 crore to 68 lakh women; a State Capital Region (Raipur, Nava Raipur, Durg, Bhilai); CM Helpline 1076; Seva Setu (953 services).

facts.text: Keralam turns **70**: CM **V.D. Satheesan** opened the **Festival of Keralam** (Nishagandhi Auditorium, Thiruvananthapuram). Initiatives: **Priyadarshini** free public transport for all women, **Operation Toofan** (anti-drug), a Senior Citizens Act and Department, Saral Keralam and Mission Samudra.
facts.plain: Keralam turns 70: CM V.D. Satheesan opened the Festival of Keralam (Nishagandhi Auditorium, Thiruvananthapuram). Initiatives: Priyadarshini free public transport for all women, Operation Toofan (anti-drug), a Senior Citizens Act and Department, Saral Keralam and Mission Samudra.

facts.text: Delhi CM **Rekha Gupta** approved **2,345** new posts in the **Delhi Fire Services**.
facts.plain: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta approved 2,345 new posts in the Delhi Fire Services.

facts.text: The parents of **Sahil Wakode**, an **IIT-Bombay** student who died on 18 Sept, moved the **Bombay HC** for a CBI or SIT probe. Mental health helpline **Tele MANAS: 14416**.
facts.plain: The parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT-Bombay student who died on 18 Sept, moved the Bombay HC for a CBI or SIT probe. Mental health helpline Tele MANAS: 14416.

facts.text: The **Pahalgam attack** (22 April 2025, Baisaran meadow) killed 26 civilians; India responded with **Operation Sindoor** on 7 May 2025 and many Pakistani nationals were sent back via **Attari-Wagah**.
facts.plain: The Pahalgam attack (22 April 2025, Baisaran meadow) killed 26 civilians; India responded with Operation Sindoor on 7 May 2025 and many Pakistani nationals were sent back via Attari-Wagah.

facts.text: J&K and Ladakh HC sought an update on bringing back **Aasim Sajjad**, the Pakistan-born son of an Indian from Rajouri, deported after the **Pahalgam attack**; it had asked the MHA to decide his citizenship plea under **Section 5(1)(d) of the Citizenship Act, 1955**.
facts.plain: J&K and Ladakh HC sought an update on bringing back Aasim Sajjad, the Pakistan-born son of an Indian from Rajouri, deported after the Pahalgam attack; it had asked the MHA to decide his citizenship plea under Section 5(1)(d) of the Citizenship Act, 1955.

facts.text: Kerala Crime Branch alleged deliberate manipulation in the **Kerala PSC** exam for the State Planning Board (10 questions excluded from evaluation); ex-Deputy Secretary **P. Satheesh** was arrested and KPSC chair **M.R. Baiju** is under scrutiny.
facts.plain: Kerala Crime Branch alleged deliberate manipulation in the Kerala PSC exam for the State Planning Board (10 questions excluded from evaluation); ex-Deputy Secretary P. Satheesh was arrested and KPSC chair M.R. Baiju is under scrutiny.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu raised the upper age limit for direct recruitment to State government services by **five years** (order by CM **C. Joseph Vijay**).
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu raised the upper age limit for direct recruitment to State government services by five years (order by CM C. Joseph Vijay).

facts.text: Census 2027 Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) notified: **online self-enumeration from 10 Jan 2027**, door-to-door **25 Jan-28 Feb 2027**. In poll-bound **U.P., Goa, Uttarakhand and Punjab**: self-enumeration from 16 Nov 2026 and door-to-door **1 Dec 2026-5 Jan 2027**. Snow-bound areas (Ladakh, parts of J&K, H.P., Uttarakhand) finished by 30 Sept.
facts.plain: Census 2027 Phase 2 (Population Enumeration) notified: online self-enumeration from 10 Jan 2027, door-to-door 25 Jan-28 Feb 2027. In poll-bound U.P., Goa, Uttarakhand and Punjab: self-enumeration from 16 Nov 2026 and door-to-door 1 Dec 2026-5 Jan 2027. Snow-bound areas (Ladakh, parts of J&K, H.P., Uttarakhand) finished by 30 Sept.

facts.text: The **National Food Security Act, 2013** covers up to **75% rural and 50% urban** population; free grain under **PMGKAY** was extended for five years from **1 Jan 2024**.
facts.plain: The National Food Security Act, 2013 covers up to 75% rural and 50% urban population; free grain under PMGKAY was extended for five years from 1 Jan 2024.

facts.text: Karnataka seized **17.78 lakh kg** of diverted PDS rice and grains since 1 Aug (Belagavi over 5 lakh kg), filed 238 FIRs and arrested 215. Food Minister: **Rizwan Arshad**.
facts.plain: Karnataka seized 17.78 lakh kg of diverted PDS rice and grains since 1 Aug (Belagavi over 5 lakh kg), filed 238 FIRs and arrested 215. Food Minister: Rizwan Arshad.

facts.text: New Census questions include caste (for non-SC/ST), religion, parents' place and date of birth, number of bank accounts, spouse's name, nationality, digital literacy, place of COVID-19 vaccination, passport and driving licence, and mobile/Aadhaar/voter ID numbers. Caste options include 'does not want to declare' and 'No Caste'.
facts.plain: New Census questions include caste (for non-SC/ST), religion, parents' place and date of birth, number of bank accounts, spouse's name, nationality, digital literacy, place of COVID-19 vaccination, passport and driving licence, and mobile/Aadhaar/voter ID numbers. Caste options include 'does not want to declare' and 'No Caste'.

facts.text: Census Phase 2 (population enumeration) door-to-door starts **1 Dec 2026** in U.P. and three other poll-bound States; the rest of India follows in **Feb 2027**. Each enumeration block has 750-800 people; each household takes 20-25 minutes.
facts.plain: Census Phase 2 (population enumeration) door-to-door starts 1 Dec 2026 in U.P. and three other poll-bound States; the rest of India follows in Feb 2027. Each enumeration block has 750-800 people; each household takes 20-25 minutes.

facts.text: The 2024 NTA reform panel was headed by ex-ISRO chief **K. Radhakrishnan**. The **Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024** allows up to **10 years** in jail and **₹1 crore** fine for organised paper leaks.
facts.plain: The 2024 NTA reform panel was headed by ex-ISRO chief K. Radhakrishnan. The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 allows up to 10 years in jail and ₹1 crore fine for organised paper leaks.
keys: Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024

facts.text: Op-ed (Furqan Qamar) argues India's layers of entrance and recruitment tests (JEE, NEET, CUET, CLAT, NATA, GATE, CAT, NET; UPSC, SSC, IBPS) should give way to moderated board and university results; the **NTA** was reviewed by a 2024 committee and another high-powered committee was set up in **July 2026**.
facts.plain: Op-ed (Furqan Qamar) argues India's layers of entrance and recruitment tests (JEE, NEET, CUET, CLAT, NATA, GATE, CAT, NET; UPSC, SSC, IBPS) should give way to moderated board and university results; the NTA was reviewed by a 2024 committee and another high-powered committee was set up in July 2026.

facts.text: Principle: a legislature can validate an act struck down by courts only by removing the defect the courts found; it cannot simply declare a judgment ineffective (doctrine of separation of powers).
facts.plain: Principle: a legislature can validate an act struck down by courts only by removing the defect the courts found; it cannot simply declare a judgment ineffective (doctrine of separation of powers).

facts.text: SC (Justices **J.B. Pardiwala** and **K. Vinod Chandran**) struck down Karnataka's 2022 law validating the 'corrupt' **2011 KPSC** selection of 362 Group A and B gazetted probationers, saying it was enacted to overturn court judgments.
facts.plain: SC (Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran) struck down Karnataka's 2022 law validating the 'corrupt' 2011 KPSC selection of 362 Group A and B gazetted probationers, saying it was enacted to overturn court judgments.

facts.text: U.P. revised character verification norms: people linked to organisations seeking to change the social or political system 'through violent means' are ineligible for government jobs, but political ideology alone or a pending FIR is not a bar.
facts.plain: U.P. revised character verification norms: people linked to organisations seeking to change the social or political system 'through violent means' are ineligible for government jobs, but political ideology alone or a pending FIR is not a bar.

facts.text: West Bengal Cabinet (CM **Suvendu Adhikari**) barred newly appointed school teachers recruited via the **School Service Commission** from political activity and contesting elections; existing teacher-politicians are exempt. School Education Minister: **Dipak Barman**.
facts.plain: West Bengal Cabinet (CM Suvendu Adhikari) barred newly appointed school teachers recruited via the School Service Commission from political activity and contesting elections; existing teacher-politicians are exempt. School Education Minister: Dipak Barman.

facts.text: Jamia Millia Islamia was founded in **1920** at **Aligarh** (moved to Delhi in 1925) and became a central university in **1988**. The **Lyngdoh Committee** (2006, chaired by ex-CEC **J.M. Lyngdoh**) framed rules for student union elections.
facts.plain: Jamia Millia Islamia was founded in 1920 at Aligarh (moved to Delhi in 1925) and became a central university in 1988. The Lyngdoh Committee (2006, chaired by ex-CEC J.M. Lyngdoh) framed rules for student union elections.

facts.text: **Jamia Millia Islamia** ended an 18-day student protest by fixing **15 May 2027** to approve a students' union constitution and holding polls within six weeks of **16 July 2027**, per the **Lyngdoh Committee** norms; VC: **Mazhar Asif**. JMI marked its **106th Foundation Day** (29 Oct).
facts.plain: Jamia Millia Islamia ended an 18-day student protest by fixing 15 May 2027 to approve a students' union constitution and holding polls within six weeks of 16 July 2027, per the Lyngdoh Committee norms; VC: Mazhar Asif. JMI marked its 106th Foundation Day (29 Oct).
